blocking_reason: The frozen post-v0.1.30 staging routes have one clean baseline 40-case run with all aggregate targets passing, but repeatability is not established. The next attempt aborted after 14 submitted cases because the evaluator exhausted safe control-plane reads on a TimeoutError; the following two complete 40-case attempts each had 39 passing cases and one distinct system failure (grounding.citation_chunk_not_in_candidates, then model_output_schema_error). Their aggregate metrics remained above thresholds, but they are not clean repeats. The observed fallback identity also varied between configured DeepSeek-V4-Flash and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The gate therefore remains blocked, along with the approved representative enterprise corpus, provider model revisions and billing or approved rate-derived cost, and independent human approval.

Add an approved sanitized representative enterprise corpus with independently reviewed golden labels
Capture provider model revisions and obtain provider billing data or an approved rate-derived cost calculation
Obtain independent human approval of the representative-corpus semantic review
